files.installs/minecraft/gamedash-test-run.sh:
#!/bin/sh
# gamedash-managed Minecraft server — generated by provision().
# This server's own files: <ROOT>/installs/minecraft/servers/test
. <ROOT>/secrets.conf
python3 - "<ROOT>/installs/minecraft/servers/test/server.properties" "$GAME_SERVER_PASSWORD" "$GAME_ADMIN_PASSWORD" <<'SYNC'
import re, sys
p, join, admin = sys.argv[1:4]
t = open(p, encoding="utf-8", newline="").read()     # keep its line endings
bom = "\ufeff" if t.startswith("\ufeff") else ""
t = t[len(bom):]
for key, val in (
    ('rcon.password', admin),
):
    line = key + '=' + val
    pattern = r'(?m)^' + re.escape(key + '=') + r'[^\r\n]*'
    if re.search(pattern, t):
        t = re.sub(pattern, lambda m: line, t)
    else:
        pass   # not in the file: left out
open(p, "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="").write(bom + t)
SYNC
cd "<ROOT>/installs/minecraft/servers/test" || exit 1
exec java -Xms2G -Xmx2G -Dgamedash.server=servers/test -jar "<ROOT>/installs/minecraft/server.jar" nogui
files.installs/minecraft/gamedash-test-stop.sh:
#!/bin/sh
# gamedash-managed graceful stop: ask the server to save and quit, then wait.
. <ROOT>/secrets.conf
"<PYTHON>" - 25585 "$GAME_ADMIN_PASSWORD" <<'STOP'
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '<APP>')
import monitor
monitor.source_rcon(int(sys.argv[1]), sys.argv[2], 'stop', timeout=8)
STOP
i=0
while [ $i -lt 45 ] && pgrep -f -- 'servers/test' >/dev/null; do sleep 1; i=$((i+1)); done
exit 0
